const userContent = [
  'Persona (Amy\'s system prompt):',
  $json.personaText || '(none)',
  '',
  'Tool calls made during this conversation:',
  $json.toolCallsSummary || '(none / not available)',
  '',
  'What Amy knows about the user (Honcho card):',
  JSON.stringify($json.userCardSnapshot || []),
  '',
  'Standing behavioral instructions Amy was given about the user (Honcho peer card for Amy):',
  JSON.stringify($json.userCardForAmySnapshot || []),
  '',
  $json.noTraceAvailable ? 'Note: no tool-call trace was captured for this session - do not assume tool_failure without other direct evidence in the transcript.' : '',
  '',
  'Transcript:',
  $json.transcript || '',
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { userContent } }];
